correctness.rationale: Direct reconstruction of the six actual assigned source files proves the displayed statement with no characteristic restriction. The natural-basis structure matrix [[0,1],[1,d]] has determinant -1, so E_d^2=E_d and every derived term remains E_d. For x=a e1+b e2, x^2=b^2 e1+(a^2+d b^2)e2. Thus x^2=x implies a=b^2 and either a=b=0 or b != 0 and d=b^{-1}-b^2. Since |F_q^×|=q-1<q, at least one d avoids the image and all nonzero idempotents. Every one-dimensional algebra has e^2=lambda e; lambda=0 is solvable, lambda!=0 gives nonzero idempotent lambda^{-1}e. This proves minimum dimension 2 also for characteristic 2. Independent from the package verifier, exhaustive finite-field arithmetic checked all d and all (a,b) over q=2,3,4,5,7,8,9,11, including proper extension-field arithmetic; results agree. No infinite conclusion is inferred from these finite checks.
